get.description: Read the backend-owned subscription catalog for the authenticated tenant region. Provider Plan IDs are never sent to the browser.

400.description: Region does not match the tenant account

get.description: Read the server-owned subscription entitlement and provider references for the authenticated tenant.

post.description: Create or recover one Razorpay Subscription using an application idempotency key. Owner-only.

409.description: Existing subscription or ended idempotency attempt

503.description: Provider or plan configuration is not ready

post.description: Verify the Razorpay Checkout signature and provider subscription state. Owner-only.

503.description: Provider status is not confirmed yet

post.description: Schedule cancellation at the end of the current billing cycle. No immediate cancellation or refund is performed. Owner-only.

get.description: Read the authenticated caller and tenant display context for the application shell.
Read bounded, authenticated tenant dashboard facts. Metrics without persisted source data are explicitly unavailable.
Read the authenticated tenant's server-owned onboarding draft and completion state.

put.description: Save one validated onboarding step for the authenticated tenant. Owner-only.

409.description: Earlier steps are incomplete or onboarding is already complete

post.description: Complete onboarding once the required steps (business identity, tax profile) pass server validation. Owner-only.

409.description: One or more required onboarding steps are incomplete

post.description: Send a 6-digit email OTP via Supabase Auth. Always responds 200 regardless of whether the account exists, to avoid leaking account existence. `purpose: 'signup'` lets Supabase create the Auth user on verification; `purpose: 'login'` does not.
Real self-serve signup — verifies the emailed OTP (creating the Supabase Auth user if needed), then creates a tenants row with the full business/tax profile and an owner staff_members row.

409.description: An account already exists with this email

post.description: Email+OTP login via Supabase Auth. Derives role/tenantId from the custom access token hook claims on the verified session.

get.description: List the caller's tenant's staff members. Requires manager or owner role.

post.description: Create a local counter-only staff profile with a temporary four-digit PIN. Managers can create cashiers; owners can also create managers.
Invite a new staff member (manager or cashier) into the caller's tenant. Owner-only.

201.description: Invite sent and staff row created

patch.description: Change a staff member's role. Owner-only.

post.description: Reset a local staff PIN and force a personal PIN change at the next login. Manager+.

get.description: List the caller's tenant's products with variants and current stock. Optional `search` filters to an exact-sku or partial-name match (CHECK-01/CHECK-02).

post.description: Create a product with one or more variants (D-01/D-02). SKU auto-generated per variant unless supplied.

409.description: SKU collision

get.description: Get a single product with its variants and current stock.

patch.description: Edit a variant. Price/reorderThreshold always editable; size/color/material blocked once stock has moved (D-04).

409.description: Variant identity is locked

post.description: Record a stock movement (receive/adjustment/transfer). Adjustment requires manager or owner role (D-13).

get.description: Read-only movement history for a variant.
Variants at or below their reorder threshold (INV-03).

post.description: An authenticated staff member (owner, manager, or a newly-activated invited manager/cashier) provisions/changes their own PIN. Requires a real Supabase session (authMiddleware) — never the PIN-switch mechanism. Always targets the caller's own staff_members row.

404.description: No staff record found for this account

post.description: PIN-switch the acting operator on a shared terminal. Requires an existing authenticated session (authMiddleware); does not create a new Supabase Auth session — issues a short-lived signed operator token instead (D-09/D-10).

401.description: Incorrect PIN, locked out, or unauthenticated

post.description: Change the currently PIN-authenticated cashier's personal PIN after a temporary PIN login.
End the current cashier session while keeping the organisation/device session connected.

get.description: Manager/owner audit list of cashier login/logout sessions.

post.description: Complete a checkout sale — server recomputes totals, enforces payment-sum, gates above-threshold discounts behind manager+ approval (D-05), writes sale+lines+payments+stock movements atomically. Response includes the sale's payments array.

400.description: Invalid request, variant not found, or payment sum mismatch

403.description: Discount exceeds the tenant's manager-approval threshold and the acting role is not manager+

409.description: Target shift is already closed

get.description: Look up prior sales by receipt number or customer search for returns compatibility.

400.description: A receipt number or customer search is required

get.description: List tenant-scoped sales with bounded pagination and optional safe filters.
Read tenant-scoped payment records and server-calculated collected/refunded totals.

200.description: Paginated payment records and authoritative totals

get.description: Get a single sale with its line items and payments.

post.description: Process a partial or full return/refund against a prior sale (CHECK-07, D-09 through D-12). Writes a positive-delta return stock movement and refund payment row(s) against the original payment method — server-validated against the original sale's actual payment methods (D-10).

400.description: Invalid request, over-return, refund-sum mismatch, or refund method not used on the original sale

404.description: Sale or line item not found

409.description: Target shift is already closed

get.description: List tenant-scoped customers with bounded pagination and optional safe search.
Search customers by phone, email, or name for checkout compatibility.

post.description: Resend a receipt email for a completed sale (CHECK-06) — resolves a real target email and reports the actual send outcome.

get.description: Shift history for the tenant, newest first, with staff and counter names resolved.

post.description: Open a shift with a starting cash count on a named counter (D-14, 0034). One counter holds at most one open shift.

409.description: That counter already has an open shift, or is turned off

get.description: Read the open shift for this paired counter. The result is counter-scoped, not cashier-scoped, so a cashier handover continues the same drawer shift.
Live, non-resetting shift snapshot (D-15, CASH-02).

post.description: Close a shift (Z report) — counted cash, variance, locks the shift (D-15/D-16).

409.description: Shift already closed

get.description: The tenant's counters/tills. Readable by every role so a cashier can pick one when opening a shift.

post.description: Create a counter. Names are unique per tenant case-insensitively. Requires manager or owner role.

409.description: A counter with that name already exists

get.description: Resolve the current browser/device pairing to a counter, if one exists.

post.description: Pair or reassign this browser/device to a counter. Manager/owner only.

409.description: Counter is turned off

patch.description: Rename a counter or turn it on/off. A counter with a shift open on it cannot be turned off. Requires manager or owner role.

409.description: Name already taken, or the counter has a shift open on it

delete.description: Delete a counter that has no shift history. Counters with history must be turned off instead so their Z reports keep naming them. Requires manager or owner role.

409.description: Counter has shift history and cannot be deleted

get.description: The tenant's category list, with how many products sit in each.

post.description: Create a category. Names are unique per tenant case-insensitively, so "Dairy" and "dairy" cannot both exist.

409.description: A category with that name already exists

patch.description: Rename or reorder a category. A rename applies to every product in it at once.

409.description: A category with that name already exists

delete.description: Delete a category. Products in it are NOT deleted — they become uncategorised.

post.description: Seed a starter category list for a business type. Additive and idempotent — existing names are skipped, never replaced.

get.description: Notifications for this tenant, newest first, with the unread count.

post.description: Mark every currently-unread notification read. No per-item read state in V1.

get.description: Store settings — business identity, GST fields, tax rate and discount threshold. Readable by any staff role.

patch.description: Update store settings. Owner-only. Legal name/GSTIN/PAN are not amended with the government by this call — see UI copy.

403.description: Only the owner can change store settings

get.description: List the caller's tenant's suppliers, active first.

post.description: Create a supplier. leadTimeDays is a direct input to the reorder heuristic (Phase 5 Task 5) and is required.

get.description: Get a single supplier.

patch.description: Edit a supplier, or deactivate/reactivate via isActive. There is no delete — past purchase orders keep referencing this row.

get.description: Every product this supplier is linked to, for the supplier detail page's Products supplied tab.
List the suppliers this variant is bought from, primary first — each with its own lead time, cost, and min order qty.

post.description: Link a supplier to this variant with a product-specific lead time.

409.description: This supplier is already linked to this variant

patch.description: Edit a supplier product link, or flip isPrimary.

delete.description: Unlink a supplier from this variant.

get.description: List the caller's tenant's purchase orders, newest first. Optional `status` filter.

post.description: Raise a draft purchase order against a supplier (PUR-02).

get.description: Get a single purchase order with its lines.

patch.description: Send or cancel a purchase order, or edit expected date/notes. partial/received are derived by the receipt trigger and cannot be set here.

409.description: Purchase order is already received or cancelled

post.description: Record a goods receipt. Partial receipt is the normal case. Idempotent on (tenant, clientReceiptId) — a replay returns the original receipt and changes nothing. Over-receipt is allowed but reported in overReceived.

400.description: Invalid request or lines not on this purchase order

409.description: Purchase order is draft or cancelled, or this receipt was already recorded

get.description: Current rule-based reorder suggestions (ML-01). Does not generate on read — refreshing shows the same numbers. Each suggestion carries the structured data basis that produced it (ML-03).

post.description: Recompute rule-based reorder suggestions for this tenant, replacing the previous run. Manager or owner only. This is velocity x lead time arithmetic, not a forecast.
Parse a catalog or sales CSV server-side and stage it for review. Writes nothing to the ledger. Owner-only.

400.description: The file could not be parsed

409.description: This exact file has already been imported

get.description: List recent imports for the authenticated tenant. Owner-only.
Read one staged or committed import, including its parsed preview. Owner-only.

post.description: ONBOARD-03: suggest source-column to target-field mappings. The suggestion is never persisted and never applied without owner confirmation. Owner-only.

409.description: That import has already been applied

422.description: The stored file can no longer be parsed

post.description: Apply the owner-confirmed mapping in one transaction. Imported sales are marked source=import and populate daily_sales_rollup. Owner-only.

400.description: The confirmed mapping is not usable

409.description: That import has already been applied

get.description: List the reports this store can run.
REPORT-01: run one report over a business-date range in the tenant timezone. Manager or owner.
COMMS-01: every email send attempt and its outcome. Manager or owner.
Addresses this store no longer emails, and why. Manager or owner.

post.description: Stop emailing an address. An unsubscribe suppresses offers only; a bounce or complaint suppresses everything. Owner-only.

delete.description: Allow a suppressed address again. Owner-only.

post.description: Record a delivery, bounce or complaint from the email provider. A bounce or complaint also suppresses the address. Owner-only.
